findings.result: The live Hoover overseers roster lists 'Michael G. McCaffery *'; the page legend states '* Executive Committee member', resolving the disambiguation marker noted in the target.
Board of Overseers member with Executive Committee marker; corrected the wave-3 'fellow_of' mislabel to member_of with the published role.
Chairman of Makena's Board of Directors; founding CEO December 2005 - January 2013; Managing Director since December 2005 (Makena board page; C3 AI 2021 proxy).

Director since March 2009; Lead Independent Director per 2021 proxy; Audit Committee chair per 2021 proxy with FY2025 chair transition to Kenneth A. Goldman (c3.ai leadership page, ir.c3.ai, SEC proxies).
Named to NVIDIA board 2015-03-11 (official newsroom); 2024 proxy states board service ended at the 2024 annual meeting; C3 AI leadership page states February 2015 - May 2024.
President and CEO of the Stanford Management Company 2000-2006 (NVIDIA 2015 release; Makena board page).
Chairman and CEO of Robertson Stephens; joined 1988 as Director of Investment Banking (NVIDIA 2015 release; Makena board page; CHM profile).
Trustee of the Rhodes Scholarship Trust per NVIDIA 2015 release; trustee emeritus per Computer History Museum profile; Rhodes House does not list trustees this pass.

Advisory-board memberships at Accel Partners, Crosslink Capital, Sageview Capital, Silver Lake Partners, SPO Partners & Co. and Stadium Capital Management as published in NVIDIA's 2015-03-11 announcement; current status unverified.

All listings describe the same person: Rhodes Scholar (Princeton; Oxford Merton College; Stanford GSB MBA) with the Makena/Stanford/Robertson Stephens career history, consistent middle initial G. across Hoover, NVIDIA, C3 AI and Makena sources.
KB Home directorship 2003-2015 appears in secondary insider-profile aggregators this pass; verify against KB Home SEC proxy statements before writing a relation.
Current membership of the six investment-firm advisory boards is unverified; only the 2015 NVIDIA listing was official-source available this pass.

sources.quote: McCaffery, age 61, is chairman and managing director of Makena Capital Management, which he co-founded 10 years ago. From 2000 to 2006, he served as president and CEO of Stanford Management Co., which oversees Stanford University's endowment. He was previously chairman and CEO of the Robertson Stephens and Co. investment bank. ... McCaffery serves as a trustee of the Rhodes Scholarship Trust and is a director of C3 Energy. He is a member of the advisory boards of Accel Partners, Crosslink Capital, Sageview Capital, Silver Lake Partners, SPO Partners & Co. and Stadium Capital Management.
